verdict.rationale: Capacities documents Bearer-token authentication for its REST API, including user tokens (`cap-api-…`) and OAuth 2.0 RFC 6750 Bearer usage. Nothing in the evidence shows these credentials can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege for an agent. A generic API token is an adjacent capability, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
